name: creative-ops-erp
description: Creative Operations ERP for marketing agencies

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:prod -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
